summary: Batch (e) Marketing SEO blitz verified end-to-end. Backend /api/tradecheck/stats public endpoint passes (returns all 4 keys, correct types, no auth). 7 new marketing pages render correctly with all interactions (Blog filter+search, Templates download, Fine calculator live updates, State guides, Compare table, Integrations filter). Pricing social-proof badges visible. Nav + Footer updates present. Regression on auth/dashboard/pricing tiers holds. 2 minor findings: (1) only 12 templates instead of 13 as stated in PRD, (2) social-proof copy reads '1 VERIFIED AUSTRALIAN TRADIES' (plural grammar with singular count).

issues: Verified-count badge shows '1 VERIFIED AUSTRALIAN TRADIES ON TRADECHECK' — grammar mismatch for singular count. Consider pluralisation helper or fallback to '120+' when count < 10 for credibility.
PRD/review request expects 13 template cards but TEMPLATES array in /app/frontend/src/content/marketingData.js contains only 12 entries. Either add 1 more template or update PRD.

action_items: Optional: Add a 13th template to /app/frontend/src/content/marketingData.js TEMPLATES array (e.g., 'Emergency response plan' or 'PPE sign-on register') to match PRD/review spec.

Optional: Pluralise verified-count label on /pricing badge — currently '1 VERIFIED AUSTRALIAN TRADIES'. Use `stats.verified_count === 1 ? 'TRADIE' : 'TRADIES'` OR keep fallback '120+' until seed data reaches ≥10 verified listings.
critical_code_review_comments: Social-proof badge on Pricing reads '{count} VERIFIED AUSTRALIAN TRADIES' regardless of count — pluralisation bug.
TEMPLATES count is 12 though spec says 13 — inconsistent with marketing claim of 'complete library'.

BlogPost related-articles section is category-filtered and slice(0,3) — works, but if a post has no category peers the whole section disappears silently. Consider fallback to 'More articles' showing most recent 3.
seed_data_creation: None created by this test run. Existing tradecheck_listings collection appears to hold 1 verified listing (drives the 1-verified badge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch (e) is production-ready. Public marketing pages verified: /blog (20 articles, search+category filter), /blog/:slug, /templates (12 cards, .txt download working), /compare (5 competitors + table), /guides (+/guides/NSW), /tools/fine-calculator (live updates for state/category/entity/severity/firstOffence), /integrations (12 cards, 7 categories), /pricing (3 social-proof badges + 3 tiers preserved). Backend endpoint GET /api/tradecheck/stats is public (no auth) and returns {verified_count,total_count,trade_count,state_count}. Nav has data-testid=nav-compare & nav-blog. Footer Resources column intact. Only 2 minor cosmetic/data issues noted — non-blocking.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Template count discrepancy is a pure data issue (array length = 12 vs spec = 13). Pluralisation issue is a trivial string-template fix.
